projects.title: AWS IaaS - ASIS Projetos
projects.description:
CI&T was responsible to move servers from on-premise infrastructure to AWS (Amazon Web Services) cloud infrastructure, maintain and evolve the infrastructure, accompanying ASIS expansion. It was divided in 3 different phases. During the period of contract CI&T supported the L1, L2 and sometimes L3 for the whole infrastructure.

In the first phase, CI&T moved servers that were serving some internal application like Moodle, Zimbra mail server, BIND DNS server, FTP service and the following sites below:
http://www.asisprojetos.com.br/
http://www.asiscursos.com.br/
http://www.spednews.com.br/
http://www.efdpiscofins.com.br/
http://www.meetingfiscal.com.br
The sites were LAMP, Wordpress and own house made platform.

In the second phase, CI&T:
- Assumed the administration of digital certificates for the web sites
- Moved the DNS service from Linux BIND to AWS Route 53 and assumed the administration
- Established a VPN between AWS VPC and customer network

In the third phase, CI&T:
- CI&T deployed approximately 100 Google Apps accounts and helped ASIS team to move all e-mail data from Zimbra to Google
